key_insight: KaiNinja extends a native single-mesh 3D generator to produce part-level assets by replacing the single O-Voxel volume with a dual-volume representation that can model touching part interfaces.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster, higher-quality part-aware 3D generation for editing, rigging, and simulation without relying on a separate segmentation stage.
method: Builds on TRELLIS.2 and reformulates its O-Voxel representation into two volumes.
Removes the need for post hoc mask prediction or mesh segmentation.
Trains on mixed part-level data, including CAD models and LLM-agent-authored assets.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved performance versus other part-generation pipelines, including 40% lower whole-object Chamfer distance and 16% higher strict part F-score.
watch_item: The dual-volume design may increase representation complexity and depends on high-quality part-level training data to preserve interface accuracy.
paper_title: Kaininja: Extending Native 3D Generators to the Part Level
